notes.title: Hotfix 1.3.6
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Neospace friends[/b]

We are now almost finished with the first update from the roadmap, but we have received a few bugs that we have now fixed for you.

[b]Changelog[/b]

-Language setting had stopped working this has now been fixed
-Black cinema bar added at first game start
-Main menu new graphics added for the main version of Neospace

We thank you and wish you continued enjoyment with Neospace Prologue
Robin Hoffmann - DreamStudios CEO

notes.title: Hotfix 1.3.5
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Neospace friends[/b]

We are still in the first major update of the roadmap, but as with the last patch, new things have been reported through the F1 tool and of course we have fixed these things for you directly

[b]Changelog[/b]

-Chip no longer speaks through walls and ceilings in the hub
-The key card had motion blur when moving quickly, this has now been removed
-If you turn off the blur and start it again after completing the prologue, the setting resets this has now been fixed

We thank you and wish you continued enjoyment with Neospace Prologue
Robin Hoffmann - DreamStudios CEO

notes.title: Hotfix 1.3.4
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Neospace friends[/b]

We are currently working on the first major update for Neospace: Prologue, but as we have received some game bugs via our [b]F1 Tool[/b] we wanted to fix them for you as soon as possible.

[b]Changelog[/b]

-In the hub, the prolouge level progress bar was not always displayed correctly
-In the subtitle, the "he" was always left off the wrench
-Wrapping error in the texts
-spaceship racer page ratios at different resolution has been fixed
-Audio slider on tablet now does not start in the middle of recording

We thank you and wish you continued enjoyment with Neospace Prologue
Robin Hoffmann - DreamStudios CEO

notes.title: Hotfix 1.3.3
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Neospace friends[/b]

We have received even more bugs in the last 2 days through [u]our F1 tool[/u] so today's patch will be a bit bigger. We also have a lot more things that will improve the game and that you have requested, we will put these [u]into 2 bigger updates[/u], these are the updates you can see on the [u]roadmap[/u].

[b]Changelog[/b]

-Man was stuck in 2 places in the hub
-All reported spelling mistakes have been fixed
-In the hub, "Chip" now speaks louder and has a larger radius
-The dubbing voices often did not match the text, this has been fixed
-One dialog was missing in English
-Hologram now stands in front of who is speaking something
-Audio Disk 5 now shows the names of the characters before the sentences
-In the hub of the asteroid minigame the shot would be adjusted so it should be easier to hit (don't want to make it too easy either)

We thank you and wish you continued enjoyment with Neospace Prologue
Robin Hoffmann - DreamStudios CEO

notes.title: Hotfix 1.3.2
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Neospace friends[/b]

As promised last time, we have now taken [u]your feedback[/u] from the ratings and the [u]F1 Tool[/u] and made another hotfix out of it.

[b]Changelog[/b]

[i]-Screw key is written in English that you have to turn it in, but you have to turn it out, this would now be translated differently
-Help system, which is in the right corner, would be renamed to interaction system
-The initial screen "Press a Button to Start..." is now easier to read
-In the hub, the water drip sounds would be made quieter and fixed so that you can no longer hear it on the floor above[/i]

We thank you and wish you continued enjoyment with Neospace Prologue
Robin Hoffmann - DreamStudios CEO

notes.title: Hotfix 1.3.1
notes.notes:
[b]Hey dear Neospace friends![/b]

We have received [u]your feedback[/u], which you have diligently shared with us in the Steam reviews, in our built-in [u]F1 tool[/u] and in the numerous livestreams. We will now fix these in [u]regular updates[/u].

[b]Changelog[/b]

[i]-The spaceship at the beginning disappears from time to time
-Password terminal you can no longer enter infinite numbers if you enter 15 numbers now comes an error and the numbers are reset
-Secret Achievement spelling error fixed[/i]

We would like to thank you and wish you continued enjoyment with Neospace Prologue
Robin Hoffmann - DreamStudios CEO
